BiblicalUsage: When the text says rîy, it means irrigation, that is a shower. It stands in Job 37:11: "Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rîy is in the Bible for a reason, and even one mention is enough for God.
